/scripts.value:
command createTables
	global gProject, gProjectName, gReAuthDeveloper
	local tTablesNeeded, tKeys, tAuthResultA, tAuthed
	
	//CHECK FOR TABLES
	if cdb_tableID("Quizzes_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "Quizzes_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("Questions_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "Questions_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("StudentAnswers_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "StudentAnswers_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("ImageScanSets_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "ImageScanSets_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("ImageScans_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "ImageScans_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("QuizCollections_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "QuizCollections_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	if cdb_tableID("MilestonesBadges_" & authedUserID) is empty then
		put "MilestonesBadges_" & authedUserID & comma after tTablesNeeded
	end if
	
	delete char -1 of tTablesNeeded
	
	if tTablesNeeded is not empty then
		//NEED TO CREATE NEW TABLES
		//AUTH DEVELOPER ACCOUNT
		switch there is a stack "Appli"
			case "True"
				get cdb_auth("support@canelasoftware.com","Code4$p33d","developer",gProject)
				break
			
			case "False"
				get cdb_auth("support@canelasoftware.com","Code4$p33d","developer",gProjectName)
				break
		end switch
		
		 //USED IN IDE TO REAUTH DEVELOPER WHEN GOING BACK TO EDIT MODE
		 put true into gReAuthDeveloper
		
		put cdb_authStatus() into tAuthResultA
		if it is false then
			 put false into tAuthed
		 else
			 put tAuthResultA["cloud"] into tAuthed
		 end if
		
		if tAuthed then
			//DEVELOPER ACCOUNT AUTHED
			//CREATE NEEDED TABLES
			repeat for each item xTableName in tTablesNeeded
				switch xTableName
					case "Quizzes_" & authedUserID
						put "QuizID,TeacherID,QuizName,QuizClass,QuizType,QuizDescription,QuizMeta,QuizCode,AvailableOnline,Active,PlayMode,Theme,StudyGuide,Settings,CollectionID,Subject,InTrash" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "Questions_" & authedUserID
						put "QuizID,QuestionID,QuestionType,QuestionText,CorrectAnswer,QuestionData,QuestionOrder,Time,CreatedBy,SeqID" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "StudentAnswers_" & authedUserID
						put "QuizID,StudentID,QuestionID,QuestionNumber,TeacherID,SelectedAnswer,SelectedAnswerText,FreeResponseText,isCorrect,AssignedQuizID,Name,BlobImages,SessionID,QuestionText,RubricScore" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "ImageScanSets_" & authedUserID
						put "SetID,SetLabel,SetDescription,TeacherID" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "ImageScans_" & authedUserID
						put "BlobID,SetID,Label,Filename,FileType,TeacherID,OpenAIFileID" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "QuizCollections_" & authedUserID
						put "CollectionID,CollectionName,CoverBlobID,TeacherID,CollectionParentID,InTrash" into tKeys
						break
					
					case "MilestonesBadges_" & authedUserID
						put "BadgeID,BadgeData,Timestamp" into tKeys
						break
				end switch
				
				switch there is a stack "Appli"
					case "True"
						get cdb_createTable(gProject, xTableName, tKeys)
						break
					
					case "False"
						get cdb_createTable(gProjectName, xTableName, tKeys)
						break
				end switch
			end repeat
			
			//RE-AUTH USER
			get_auth emailTemp, passwordTemp
			
			put cdb_authStatus() into tAuthResultA
			if it is false then
				 put false into tAuthed
			 else
				 put tAuthResultA["cloud"] into tAuthed
			 end if
			
			if tAuthed then
				//USER RE-AUTHED
			else
				//FAILED TO RE-AUTH USER
				get answerDialog("Failed to authenticate user:" && emailTemp, "OK")
			end if
		else
			//FAILED TO AUTH DEVELOPER ACCOUNT
			get answerDialog("Unable to create tables.", "OK")
		end if
	end if
	
	put empty into passwordTemp
	put empty into emailTemp
end createTables
